//: The property names liveface.js renames to short names (esbuild mangleProps; scripts/build.mjs, scripts/mangle-names.mjs).

Every private or protected member of a class in `files` is renamed unless `keep` names it, with why; `extra` adds names that are not class privates (fields of the engine's internal records) but are as safe.

A new private member is renamed without being listed here; src/__tests__/bundle-mangle.test.ts fails if it is not safe: read by another bundle, a page, the browser or the network's data. Then keep it here, saying why, or rename it.

keep.face: console probe; also read by the mouth bundle; a DOM member
keep.motion: console probe; also the widget's and the mouth bundle's motion manifest
keep.speech: console probe; also written by the widget and bodymotion.ts
keep.rig: the mouth extension contract's MouthSurfaceFrame.rig, read by the mouth bundle
keep.ctx: the mouth extension contract's ctx, read by the mouth bundle
keep.mouth: the widget's avatar config and the mouth bundle's own
keep.paintRim: the continuous mouth's own method (mouth bundle)
keep.texture: the mouth bundle's teeth texture; a DOM member
keep.source: the mouth bundle's motion source; a key of the data; a DOM member
keep.url: the widget's and the mouth bundle's; a DOM member
keep.canvas: a DOM member (CanvasRenderingContext2D.canvas); read by the widget and the mouth bundle
keep.box: a DOM member; the mouth bundle's layer boxes
keep.count: a DOM member (console.count); the mouth bundle's layer counts
keep.image: a DOM member; the mouth bundle's photos; a key of the data
keep.aPos: a shader attribute, looked up by its name as a string (warp-gl.ts)
keep.aUV: a shader attribute, looked up by its name as a string (warp-gl.ts)
keep.uMatrix: a shader uniform, looked up by its name as a string (warp-gl.ts)
keep.compile: a member of the language's objects (WebAssembly.compile)
keep.random: Math.random; written by bodymotion.ts and headmotion.ts
keep.picture: the widget's failure stage 'picture' (widget/load.ts), a string the quoted-name check cannot tell from a key
